Commentary newest first

    How it’s drawn

    The hall is real 3D geometry, rendered small (the pixel size slider sets how small), outlined wherever depth jumps, then snapped to one fixed palette of 90 colours. Nothing is a sprite, and nothing is downloaded: the sound is synthesised in your browser.

    Teams, players and sponsors are invented. Scoring is real volleyball: rally points, sets to 25 (15 in the decider) won by two, the six rotate after every side-out, a libero in a different shirt, two timeouts and two video challenges a set.
